svg.title: EvoLink-Bench — interdependent task streams
svg.desc: Two benchmark cases flank the evaluation protocol. In L1, the agent revises a rule for grading evidence and recalls it after other requests. In L2, a housing model reuses prepared feature tables before a later entailment probe. The center shows a bounded feedback loop, workspace artifacts, learning state, and three persistence conditions.

g.text: The final submission determines the turn reward.
What does the agent carry forward?
